# geobridge_pairspace_experiments_indirect

GeoBRIDGE **pair-space** experiments with **indirect** synthetic effects (higher-order propagation in velocity), plus benchmark and pancreas real-data scripts.

## What this repo adds

- Indirect effects in synthetic velocity via `XW + alpha * XW^2` (and further hops if `indirect_hops > 2`)
- Drift types: `none`, `linear`, `nonlinear`, `branch_specific`
- EDP@50 and plot saving with explicit metric names

**Synthetic interpretation:** topology defines branching and sampling order; velocity is generated by the simulation rule; indirect effects are injected through higher-order network propagation terms.

## Repository layout

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `geobridge_model/` | Core GeoBRIDGE model, pair-space accumulation, scoring |
| `benchmark/` | Synthetic data, sweeps, metrics, figures (paper Fig.2 style) |
| `real_1_Pancreas/` | Pancreas Fig.3-style analysis (`pancreas_fig3.py`, helpers) |
| `outputs/pancreas_runs/` | Archived pancreas diagnostic runs (tables, figures, manifests) |
| `generated/` | Synthetic datasets produced by `run_all.py` / smoke scripts |
| `results/` | Benchmark outputs (plots, tables) |
| `data/`, `simdata/` | Input or auxiliary data (as used by your local workflows) |
| `docs/` | **GitHub Pages** static site (`index.html`) |

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Run from the **repository root** so `geobridge_model` and `benchmark` import correctly.

## Quick run (benchmarks)

```bash
python run_all.py --reps 3 --drift-reps 2 --n-cells 400 --indirect-strength 0.35
```

Smoke test:

```bash
python run_smoke_example.py
```

## Pancreas (real data)

```bash
python -m real_1_Pancreas.pancreas_fig3
```

See `real_1_Pancreas/README.md` for outputs and optional Enrichr usage.

To merge several run folders into one CSV (paths under `outputs/pancreas_runs/` or any `--outdir` you used):

```bash
python real_1_Pancreas/build_diag_comparison.py --runs outputs/pancreas_runs/run_a outputs/pancreas_runs/run_b
```

Default merged file: `outputs/pancreas_diag_comparison.csv`.

## GitHub Pages

1. Push this repository to GitHub.
2. **Settings → Pages → Build and deployment:** source **Deploy from a branch**, branch **main** (or default), folder **`/docs`**.
3. Edit `docs/index.html` and set the `href` on the repository link(s) to your real GitHub URL (search for `https://github.com/`).

The site will be served at `https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/` (or your custom domain).
